the_false_statement.supporting_text: the second case has not been delivered
the_false_statement.why_it_is_wrong: the prepared second case operands existed at 2026-09-14T16:23:49Z in the engine-case-portability checkpoint, 21 minutes before this preregistration was recorded at 2026-09-14T16:45:20Z. The case existed. Saying it did not was a claim about the world made from this lane's own inbox

the_lesson_registered: this lane has now made three claims about the world from inside its own inbox: that nobody runs this analysis, that its rigor exceeds named companies', and that a case did not exist because it had not arrived here. All three are withdrawn. The pattern is asserting absence from local absence, and it is now a named failure mode

what_is_true_instead.method: every file under the two Engine checkpoints was read and timestamped by this lane, and the decision values were searched for directly
